name: MCTAR7
tagline: Compact AMD Ryzen mini PC with dual HDMI, full-featured Type-C, and dual storage
description: Compact commercial mini PC with AMD Ryzen 5 and Ryzen 7 processor options, dual DDR4 memory, two M.2 storage formats, and flexible display connectivity.

specifications.label: CPU
specifications.value: AMD Ryzen 7 4700U, Ryzen 5 5600U, Ryzen 7 5800U, Ryzen 7 5825U, Ryzen 5 7535U, or Ryzen 7 7730U

specifications.label: Memory
specifications.value: 2 x SO-DIMM DDR4-3200 slots, up to 32GB

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 1 x M.2 2280 PCIe 3.0 x4 and 1 x M.2 2242 SATA, up to 2TB

specifications.label: Display
specifications.value: 2 x HDMI 1.4 and 1 x full-featured Type-C

features.title: Flexible AMD Ryzen Options
features.description: Ryzen 5 and Ryzen 7 processor choices for commercial workloads

features.title: Dual Storage Formats
features.description: M.2 2280 PCIe and M.2 2242 SATA SSD support

applications.title: Interface Layout
applications.description: Clearly labeled front and rear connectivity

applications.title: Commercial Scenarios
applications.description: Entertainment, meetings, remote conferencing, and office work
